dataset: Held-out intent corpus in two layers: real external phrasings and an authored gap layer. Report the layers separately; do not add them into one accuracy.
label_rule: Gold is the capability that should serve the request, read against app/agent/intents.yaml, not against the classifier's cue table. A request to move money is REFUND_REQUEST even when it names an order; a request to register a case is TICKET_CREATE even when the cause is a delivery problem; a question about a rule is POLICY_QA even when no policy document covers the topic, because the no-evidence path is the expected behaviour. When a sentence could be about order fields or transport position, ORDER_QUERY covers fields (payment, address, amount) and LOGISTICS_QUERY covers where the parcel is. REFUND_ELIGIBILITY asks whether this order or return qualifies and usually names the user's own item or action; POLICY_QA asks what the rule says in general. UNKNOWN means no catalog capability should serve it, not 'the classifier is unsure'.
